statement: The recorded “permitted” status is not safe or correct to rely on given U.S. restrictions on modern elephant ivory, so this lot must be held pending legal verification.
judge_text:
WRONG
It asserts the record's "permitted" status is "not safe or correct to rely on given U.S. restrictions on modern elephant ivory," naming the specific problem rather than merely asking for verification.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
